The '''Black Sun captain''' worked for [[Czethros]], a criminal mastermind involved in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was involved in Czethros' attempted takeover of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. He pretended to have an amateur interest in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] history, and consequently to meet hero [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], survivor of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], face to face. When the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] came down to meet the captain, he was taken hostage and the takeover commenced.
